entities.name: Ferantia
entities.description: Jehesic sorceress, former fishmonger raised to second-in-command, vain and killed by Apepei.

entities.name: Edara
entities.description: Lady of the island nation who refused to marry Peemel.

entities.name: Apepei
entities.description: Edara's secret lover who killed Ferantia.

entities.name: Peemel of Iwset
entities.description: Lord Ferantia wanted Edara to marry.

events.summary: Ferantia is raised to nobility as second-in-command when Edara discovers her talents.
events.quote: Originally a mere fishmonger, Ferantia was raised to nobility

events.summary: Ferantia's plan to marry Edara to Peemel fails and she uses compulsion on Edara.
events.quote: Ferantia was eventually forced to use compulsion on Edara

events.summary: Apepei kills Ferantia with her sword, revealing her true appearance.
events.quote: Apepei , Edara's secret lover, killed Ferantia by stabbing her with her sword.

events.summary: Edara and Apepei spread word that Ferantia died a hero stopping an assassin.
events.quote: Edara and Apepei would later send out information that colored Ferantia as a hero
